name: Wattson
tagline: A desk-lamp robot companion that reacts to your mood with gestures, conversation and small games.
problem: Long solo study sessions feel isolating.
solution: A five-axis lamp arm on a Raspberry Pi reads voice tone, answers with expressive gestures and speech, and plays games such as coin flips and rock-paper-scissors.
demo_moment: Team-described: Wattson recognises you and cheers you on with gestures.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “LeLamp: Hack the Human-Robot Experience” among 160 submissions.
Focuses on presence and personality rather than utility.

lessons: Give an everyday object a personality and the demo becomes memorable.
